title: Renegade Balloons
specs: Flight altitude up to a couple thousand feet depending on wind
Minimum age 10 years old and at least 48 inches tall
Must be able to stand unassisted for at least one hour
Must be able to climb unassisted in and out of the basket
No pregnancy, recent surgery, knee or back issues
Passengers under 18 must have parent or legal guardian sign waiver and accompany them
includes: Experienced chase crew vehicle to follow balloon and return guests to meeting place
gap: Price for the hot air balloon flight is not stated
blurb: Guests experience a hot air balloon flight averaging 45 minutes to 1 hour, with the entire experience lasting about 2.5 to 3 hours including preparation and celebration. Flights cover between 4 and 10 miles and include a chase crew to return guests to the meeting point. Static tether balloon rides are also available, which do not leave the ground.
extraNote: Cancel at least 48 hours before scheduled flight to avoid forfeiture of deposit · Flight may be postponed or cancelled due to weather such as winds above limits, fog, thunderstorms within 100 miles, rain, excessive heat, or fronts
